description: .NET version upgrade plan from .NET 8.0 to .NET 10.0 LTS

tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested upgrading to the latest LTS version. .NET 10.0 is the current latest LTS release. Additionally, .NET 8.0 reaches end of support on November 10, 2026, making a timely upgrade to .NET 10.0 necessary to remain on a supported, long-term supported version with continued security patches and platform improvements.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade all projects in the eShopOnWeb solution (ApplicationCore, Infrastructure, Web, PublicApi, BlazorAdmin, BlazorShared, and all test projects) from net8.0 to net10.0. Update the centrally-managed target framework in Directory.Packages.props, update the SDK version in global.json, update all NuGet package versions to .NET 10-compatible releases (including ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, and all third-party packages), and resolve any API breaking changes or compatibility issues introduced between .NET 8 and .NET 10.
tasks.summary: Upgraded eShopOnWeb solution from .NET 8.0 to .NET 10.0 LTS. Updated global.json SDK to 10.0.x, updated TargetFramework to net10.0 in Directory.Packages.props, upgraded all NuGet packages (ASP.NET Core, EF Core, Azure.Identity, JWT), replaced deprecated AutoMapper package, removed packages now part of the framework, fixed API breaking changes (SYSLIB0051 serialization constructor, CS0433 extern alias). All 74 tests pass (UnitTests: 44, IntegrationTests: 3, FunctionalTests: 12, PublicApiIntegrationTests: 15).
